name: Web Components | a11y-elements
tagline: Framework-agnostic accessibility Custom Elements: a behavior layer for real markup, not a themed UI kit.

keyPoints: Accessibility: The core. Semantic foundations and accessible interactions.

popTagline: Built to stop rewriting the same accessibility behavior in every project.
popOverview: A framework-agnostic library of accessible Web Components, providing reusable interface elements and interaction patterns without imposing a framework or design system. Built around native browser capabilities, it aims to make accessible interfaces easier to integrate and customize.

features.sectionContent: A framework-agnostic library of accessible Web Components, providing reusable interface elements and interaction patterns without imposing a framework or design system. Built around native browser capabilities, it aims to make accessible interfaces easier to integrate and customize.

sectionKeyPoints.Lorem: Around 30 custom elements covering form controls, navigation, images, loading states and overlays.

sectionKeyPoints.Dolor: Native form validation enhanced with custom validators, contextual errors and reusable field components.

sectionKeyPoints.Tempor: A complete set of overlay patterns: modals, drawers, dropdowns, tooltips, notifications and more.

sectionKeyPoints.Lorem: Framework-agnostic by design: a behavior layer rather than a themed UI kit, usable with vanilla JavaScript or any frontend framework.

sectionKeyPoints.Dolor: Light DOM architecture, without Shadow DOM, keeps the underlying markup accessible and directly styleable.

sectionKeyPoints.Tempor: Native form controls remain the source of truth, while documented CSS custom properties and an opt-in dark theme leave presentation in the developer's hands.

sectionKeyPoints.Lorem: Implementing consistent keyboard interaction and focus management across different browsers, components and interaction patterns.

sectionKeyPoints.Dolor: Handling complex overlay behavior: focus containment and restoration, background inertness, dismissal rules and screen-reader announcements.

sectionKeyPoints.Tempor: Maintaining reliable distribution across modular ESM imports and standalone browser bundles, with a test suite covering 700+ tests across 50 files.
